title: Split-Gaussia Protein Complementation Assay in Presence of a Third Protein Under Viral Infection
author: Benoit Besson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jekcjcw

substeps.instruction: Plate 25,000 cells per well in 100 µL of DMEM+10%FBS.

steps.title: Infect Cells with Rabies Virus
steps.instruction: Infect cells with rabies virus 3 hours prior to transfection.

substeps.instruction: Remove 50 µL of media from each well.
Add 50 µL of rabies virus at MOI 1 in DMEM without FBS.

steps.title: Prepare and Add DNA Transfection Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a DNA mix and transfect the cells using Lipofectamine 2000.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL DNA mix in DMEM without FBS containing 100 ng Glu1-tagged protein, 100 ng Glu2-tagged protein, 100 ng cmyc-tagged protein, and 2 ng firefly luciferase plasmid (e.g., pGL4.50) per well (minimum 3 wells per condition).
Add 0.5 µL of Lipofectamine 2000 to 25 µL of DMEM without FBS.
Combine the Lipofectamine solution with the DNA mix and incubate for 30 min.
Gently add 50 µL of the mixture to the cells.

steps.title: Perform Luciferase Assay
steps.instruction: Lyse cells and measure luciferase activity.

substeps.instruction: Remove all medium from the wells.
Add 50 µL of Renilla Luciferase Assay Lysis Buffer (Promega) and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Add 15 µL of cell lysate to 30 µL of Renilla Luciferase Assay Reagent and read immediately.
Add 15 µL of cell lysate to 15 µL of Firefly Luciferase Assay Reagent and read immediately.

steps.title: Calculate Normalized Luminescence Ratio
steps.instruction: Process the luminescence data to determine the NLR.

substeps.instruction: Normalize each Gaussia luciferase value according to the Firefly luciferase value.
Calculate the Normalized Luminescence Ratio (NLR) using the formula: NLR = signal ( Glu1-A + Glu2-B ) / [ signal ( Glu1-A + Glu2 ) + signal ( Glu1 + Glu2-B ) ].
Perform a logarithmic transformation of the NLR values.
